query: Our scorecard shows onboarding completion up from 41% to 58%, while paid conversion is unchanged at 9% for six weeks. Run the weekly review. The metric owners and targets are listed in the ledger.
expected_behavior: Starts from the target-backed scorecard and identifies the unchanged paid conversion as the stuck lagging result
Treats onboarding completion as a leading signal and the unchanged paid conversion as evidence the link may be weak or delayed, not proof of causation
Checks the metric definition, cohort, and timeframe before recommending a change
Produces a concrete decision with one owner and logs or proposes a dec- entry; does not claim the leading metric is success
